messages:
maria_g: Heads-up: we are GAing StreamShell tomorrow at 09:00 PT — this is our hosted streaming + tool-calling surface that bundles adaptive routing, first-class function/tool params, and low-latency multiplexing. Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/streamshell (please read before the call).
ajay_k: 🎉 awesome! is this replacing the existing /stream-tool endpoint or an additional one? migration path?
maria_g: It's additive for GA: new endpoints are `/v1/streamshell/gen` (streaming generation) and `/v1/streamshell/call` (tool-calling). We will mark the old `/stream-tool` as deprecated in 90 days; migration guide is in the docs.
sophia_l: Ops notes for Dedicated/Private: no infra changes required to accept traffic, but customers using custom proxies should add the new header `x-rw-streamshell-version: 1`.
jordan_ops: @maria_g confirmed — infra deploy window scheduled tonight 01:00 PT, deploy-bot will run smoke tests. Alerting has been updated: latency SLOs on the new endpoints added to console dashboards.
deploy-bot: deploy started at 01:04 PT to hosted-prod. smoke tests: PASS. Canary traffic shifted to 5% for 30m.
ajay_k: For SDKs — will there be new client methods or opt-in flags?
maria_g: SDKs v3.4 will ship alongside GA with `client.streamshell()` helpers. We kept the old `stream()` APIs for backward compatibility during the 90-day window.
sophia_l: Quick note for support: new error code 4501 = tool-timeout (when a tool call exceeds configured tool timeout). Support runbook added: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/streamshell-errors
jordan_ops: Can we get a short checklist for on-call? I posted a minimal ops checklist in the docs but copying key checks here: 1) verify canary alerts, 2) check kv-cache hit rates after rollout, 3) confirm fallback routing to mosaic-lite if capacity constrained.
maria_g: Thanks — we're doing a launch Q&A at 10:30 PT in #all-hands. Join if you want to ask product/infra/SDK questions. If you have customers on Dedicated/Private with pinned proxies, ping solutions-eng for rollout coordination.
ajay_k: Any rate-limit changes?
maria_g: Default rate limits unchanged. We added a per-project concurrent-streams quota that you can tune in Console (defaults to 8).
sophia_l: FYI: created an internal migration tracker sheet and shared with Solutions and AMs. Link posted in #customer-success.
jordan_ops: I'll keep an eye on any error-rate regressions during the first 2 hours. Ping me if you see 5xx spikes.
maria_g: Appreciate y'all — let's keep bug reports and small regressions in a single thread (this one) so we can triage fast. :rocket:
